paper: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM (T-RO 2021)
recorded_with: reproduce.py: Examples/Stereo-Inertial/stereo_inertial_euroc on EuRoC MH_01 (ASL format, from the HuggingFace mirror), evaluated with the repository's own evaluation/evaluate_ate_scale.py against evaluation/Ground_truth/EuRoC_imu/MH_GT.txt
note: Table II, p.7: stereo-inertial RMS ATE on EuRoC MH01 = 0.036 m. Three runs of the same command on this machine gave 0.0454 / 0.0351 / 0.0416 m - one matches the paper almost exactly and the spread brackets it, which is what a multithreaded SLAM system does. The baseline is the first run because run_all.py re-runs and backtests it; the tolerance is wide enough to cover the measured spread.
